stream.description: false means the caller wants only a terminal result, no event stream.

answer.description: Answers a question the conversation is still waiting on, for a caller that was asked something and could not answer before the run gave up. It needs a conversation_token and takes the place of a prompt, so the run is resumed rather than given a new turn.

tool_use_id.description: The call the question was about, taken from the question.

kind.description: The question that was asked, taken from the question. It says what the answer means where the answer value alone cannot, since no_operator is the same value for all four.

answer.description: Which field below carries the answer, as on an elicit reply. index and waiting have no meaning here: the run that offered the options has ended, so a selection names the option it chose rather than a position into a list the receiver no longer holds.

value.description: Answers an input question, where an empty string is a valid answer, and a select question, where it is the option that was chosen.
